items.claim: properties panel "Text" writes `data.text` alone, so a node with runs never shows the edit
items.note: `TEXT_PROPERTIES.settle` splices the changed span into the runs, and new text takes the style of the run to its left, as the 2026-11-11 ruling in `docs/unruled.md` says. It needed `replaceRunRange` and `runStyleAt` exported from text-dom: 875dcd17cf, minor changeset.

items.claim: rotated clipped text outline keeps glyphs that sit in its box's axis-aligned bounds
`fit: 'shrink'` paint memo keeps the fit from before the face loaded
items.note: This changes a paint cache key (one counter sum read per paint). I did not benchmark it before and after on the fleet, which the repo's rule for cache changes asks for; the controller should queue that bench.

items.claim: double-click on glyphs drawn past the box doesn't open them, though a click selects
items.note: A click is also gated on the pose box (`scenePointQuery.ts:38-40` checks `poseContainsRotated` before the silhouette), so a click on overflow glyphs selects nothing either. Click and double-click agree.

items.claim: canvas editor's stand-in hides the edited glyphs on every canvas of the scene sharing its offset parent
